scope: The 26 named stranded members were independently inspected. Parent archive MALICIOUS verdicts were retained without re-judgment.
method: Each member received atomscan --no-update --mode slow --follow=none --format json, cleave facts, direct source/control-flow or ZIP record inspection, and final atomscan with CLEAVE_TRAITS_DIR set to this worktree. Supplied SHA-256 values were verified. No payload was executed or connected to a peer. Raw DEFLATE probes had a one-MiB output cap.
path_reconstruction: The Debian extraction stores usr/... directly. data/usr is a symlink to ../usr so all seven supplied full member paths resolve to the original extracted bytes and their adjacent markers.
decoded_content: No encoded executable layer was required to explain the payloads. Incidental Base64 interpretations of password-hash text were not considered executable obfuscation. hidden.php uses unrestricted variable-function dispatch.

trait_changes.dispatch: Move all three request-import/dynamic-call observations from request/eval to obf-dispatch, preserving matcher, scope, severity, proximity and exclusions. Update both exact YAML references and the hostile fixture expectation. TAXONOMY.md records why dynamic callable selection proves neither eval nor an OS command sink.
trait_changes.ancestor_review: The direct-http-c2 webshell selector and crystalx command-and-control selector retain membership. The multi-facet exec composite selects both obf-dispatch and request: the moved observations now supply the dispatch facet, and an independent request-webshell finding is needed for its request facet. That semantic correction follows the supported operation. No target gained that composite.
trait_changes.defacement: Replace the generic archive-defacement-banner word matcher with parent-web-path-defacement-text. It requires raw adjacency of a parent-relative PHP/HTML path and defacement wording; the hostile composite also requires parsed traversal/web-member facts. Scope is ZIP, where stored entries expose this adjacency. No PHP execution or successful extraction is claimed.
trait_changes.zip_bomb: Descriptions now state that archive metrics declare expansion, rather than implying that decompression actually completed.

controls.php: Existing hostile/php-silenced-extract-dispatch.php retains two hostile dispatch findings. New fixed-call-after-import and variable-call-without-import controls each have zero hostile and zero suspicious findings.
controls.zip: New banner-only and document-traversal controls have zero hostile findings. The full validator retains one accurate built-in suspicious ZIP-slip finding on the document-traversal fixture (score 38); its expectation permits that finding. A differently named ../landing.html entry with defaced-by wording retains both hostile findings when scanned outside the pre-existing test-directory exclusions. All ten actual traversal members retain both hostile findings.
controls.precision: test-rules: dispatch composites 7.2 and 5.3; web-defacement composite 6.0; traversal composite 4.9.

members.marker_note: Laudanum PHP command shell: no change
members.behavior: The allowed client IP gate precedes session login. POST username/password and nonce are checked against configured SHA-1 password hashes. Once authenticated, POST command becomes $command, cd updates session cwd, and other commands reach proc_open($command). Both child output streams are HTML-escaped into the session terminal output. This is an injectable operator-command payload; the access gates do not remove that function.

members.marker_note: Laudanum WordPress command shell: no change
members.behavior: Includes ipcheck.php for the client IP gate. Its command branch is explicitly if(true), bypassing the copied session-login branch. POST command reaches proc_open($command), and stdout/stderr are returned in the terminal form. Inspected sibling ipcheck.php checks REMOTE_ADDR against the three configured addresses and otherwise exits with 404; it has no process execution.

members.marker_note: WordPress command/reverse-shell plugin: no change
members.behavior: Before request dispatch, system() attempts chmod ugo-w and chattr +i on the file identified by __FILE__. The cmd request value reaches executeCommand(), which tries ReflectionFunction(system)->invoke(), call_user_func_array(), call_user_func(), passthru(), or system(). The intended reverse branch opens a socket and executes /bin/sh -i with FD 3 redirection, but uses undefined $ip/$port as request keys and assumes the socket is FD 3; it is not a reliable configured reverse connection as shipped. Permission and immutability changes depend on the executing account. The command-dispatch branch itself is an unauthenticated backdoor.

members.marker_note: Laudanum ASP command shell: no change
members.behavior: REMOTE_ADDR must equal the configured allowed IP or execution exits with 404. On form submission Request.Form("cmd") becomes cmd, WScript.Shell.Exec(cmd) starts the requested process, and StdOut.ReadAll() is written back to the response. A request can supply cmd.exe /c for shell syntax. This is an operator-command webshell payload, not automatic beaconing or an outbound connection.

members.marker_note: Laudanum JSP command WAR: no change
members.behavior: ZIP/WAR has five entries. WEB-INF/web.xml names /cmd.jsp as the Command servlet JSP. cmd.jsp accepts GET cmd and directly passes request.getParameter("cmd") to Runtime.getRuntime().exec(). It reads the child output through DataInputStream and emits each line to the HTTP response. No authentication is present. Runtime.exec(String) starts a process; shell metacharacters require a caller-supplied shell command.

members.marker_note: Overlapping ZIP bomb: clarify declared expansion
members.behavior: Python parsed all 190023 central-directory entries: 4507981427706459 bytes declared expanded output from 45876952 bytes on disk. Local-header and stream extents overlap: for example first data offset 51, next 107, while the first compressed stream is 34144733 bytes long. Bounded raw-DEFLATE probes verified embedded later ZIP headers in early streams and a megabyte of repeated a bytes from the last stream, without expanding the bomb. This is a nonrecursive overlapping-stream resource-exhaustion payload. Cleave caps expanded member observations at 65536 and reports only 1554952742338126 expanded bytes in that partial population; those metrics undercount the full central directory.

members.marker_note: Laudanum WordPress reverse shell: no change
members.behavior: At load time the script optionally forks and calls posix_setsid(), changes directory to /, sets umask(0), connects using fsockopen(), and proc_open() launches uname -a; w; id; /bin/sh -i. Nonblocking stream_select() dispatches peer reads into child stdin and child stdout/stderr back to the socket. The same $input value is copied in each relay. This is an outbound interactive shell, not a listener. The configured private address is a destination, not evidence of a contacted C2 server. This WordPress template takes ip and port from POST, defaulting to 10.2.2.1:8888; unlike the WordPress command-shell template it does not include ipcheck.php.

members.marker_note: Laudanum hidden shell: move callable dispatch out of eval
members.behavior: @extract($_REQUEST) imports attacker-selected names into local variables. @die($ctime($atime)) immediately invokes the requested PHP callable with the requested argument and sends its return value to die(); callables such as system execute a command and can emit output directly. There is no IP or credential gate. This is variable-function dispatch, not Base64, encryption, PHP eval(), or sophisticated encoded obfuscation.
